name: TA-3-cross-slope-control
why: The control for TA-3: the identical tilted plane and the identical NoData gap at (2,2), but maxCrossSlope loosened from 0.5 to 10 (effectively unconstrained), maxLongitudinalGrade unchanged at 1.5. If TA-3's NO_ROUTE actually came from the NoData cell, the vehicle width, or some other constraint rather than the directional cross-slope limit, this fixture would ALSO be NO_ROUTE. It must instead be FOUND, using a north/south move to detour around the gap — proving the only thing that changed between the two fixtures (maxCrossSlope) is what was rejecting every detour.
